instruction: How to create a Crossplane Composition with a function reference
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: with-function
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XMyApp
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
  - step: patch-and-transform
    functionRef:
      name: function-patch-and-transform
    input:
      apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      spec:
        resources:
        - name: my-bucket
          base:
            apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
            kind: Bucket
            spec:
              forProvider:
                region: us-east-1'

instruction: How to install a Crossplane function
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane/function-patch-and-transform:v0.3.0'

How to create a Crossplane XRD with an enum constraint
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xmyapps.example.crossplane.io
spec:
  group: example.crossplane.io
  names:
    kind: XMyApp
    plural: xmyapps
  claimNames:
    kind: MyApp
    plural: myapps
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              tier:
                type: string
                enum:
                - development
                - staging
                - production'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane XRD with a required field
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xmyapps.example.crossplane.io
spec:
  group: example.crossplane.io
  names:
    kind: XMyApp
    plural: xmyapps
  claimNames:
    kind: MyApp
    plural: myapps
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            required:
            - region
            properties:
              region:
                type: string'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane XRD with additional printer columns
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xmyapps.example.crossplane.io
spec:
  group: example.crossplane.io
  names:
    kind: XMyApp
    plural: xmyapps
  claimNames:
    kind: MyApp
    plural: myapps
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              region:
                type: string
    additionalPrinterColumns:
    - name: Region
      type: string
      jsonPath: .spec.region'

instruction: How to set up Crossplane with a controller configuration
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
kind: ControllerConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-config
spec:
  args:
  - --debug
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsUser: 2000
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: 1
      memory: 1Gi'

instruction: How to set up Crossplane with a deployment runtime config
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
kind: DeploymentRuntimeConfig
metadata:
  name: custom-runtime
spec:
  deploymentTemplate:
    spec:
      replicas: 2
      selector:
        matchLabels:
          pkg.crossplane.io/provider: provider-aws
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: provider
            args:
            - --debug'
